input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Both Sides Now"?

documents.text: Both Sides Now (Marina Prior album) Both Sides Now is the fourth studio album by Australian singer Marina Prior. It is her first studio album since "Somewhere – The Songs of Sondheim and Bernstein" in 1994. She says the main reason for taking so long since her last album was that she was simply busy. “The thing is because I work in theatre it is all encompassing and all consuming.
